sloka: ददौ नाग सहस्रस्य बलम् च अस्याः पितामहः ।न तु एव पुत्रम् यक्षाय ददौ च असौ महायशाः ॥१-२५-७॥
transliteration: dadau nāga sahasrasya balam ca asyāḥ pitāmahaḥ ।na tu eva putram yakṣāya dadau ca asau mahāyaśāḥ ॥1-25-7॥

translations.english: As she grew up, glowing with youth and beauty she was given in marriage to Sunda, son of Jharjha.
